topic: Projects in Claude Cowork: what they are, how to create one, three everyday workflows, when a classic chat project fits better, a 15-minute set-up and the honest limits
audience: Professionals on a paid Claude plan who already tried Cowork and want one tidy place per piece of recurring work (reports, research, proposals)
goal: Create a first Cowork project with instructions, context and memory set the way they want, run one real workflow in it, and know when a classic chat project is the better choice
notes: Anthropic describes Claude Cowork as bringing Claude Code's agentic capabilities to knowledge work beyond coding; it takes on complex, multi-step tasks instead of answering prompts one at a time. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

The intended workflow is: describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work such as formatted documents, organized files and synthesized research. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]
Cowork can produce Excel spreadsheets with working formulas, PowerPoint presentations and formatted documents. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Cowork is available only on paid plans: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise. On desktop it is on all paid plans; on web and mobile on Pro, Max, Ultra and Team (beta on Team), and on Enterprise when an owner enables it. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Projects in Cowork require the latest version of Claude Desktop; download or update at claude.com/download. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Projects in Cowork group related tasks into dedicated workspaces with their own files, context, instructions and memory. Projects work the same way in Cowork and in Claude. New projects created in Cowork are saved to your Claude account, so you can pick them up from your other devices. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

To create a project: find Projects in the left navigation panel and click the '+' button. There are three ways: 'Start from scratch' (set up a new folder with instructions and files), 'Import from project' (a 'Search projects in Chat...' field shows recent chat projects; pick one, bulk upload is not supported, name the new project, choose where to save it on your computer and click 'Create'; files and instructions transfer) and 'Use an existing folder' (pick a folder, name the project, choose where to save it, add instructions, attach files, click 'Create'). [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Each project has its own Instructions (tone, formatting or rules for all tasks in the project), Scheduled tasks (recurring tasks specific to the project), Context (add a local folder, link a chat project, or paste in a URL) and Memory. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Memory is enabled for Cowork projects: Claude remembers context from tasks in a project and applies it to future tasks in the same project; what it learns in one project doesn't carry over to other projects. A project also shares memory with chats outside projects; to keep it fully separate, turn off 'Use account memory' under Memory on the project's page. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Project sharing is available on Team and Enterprise plans: you can give people in your organization 'Can view' or 'Can edit' access and change or remove it later. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Archiving a project in Cowork removes its metadata from the UI but not locally; related files or folders on your computer are not affected. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Claude Desktop moves projects created from a folder on your computer into your Claude account: the project's name, description and instructions move, plus a copy of its memory if memory is on; the folders and files stay on your computer, nothing is uploaded or deleted. On Team and Enterprise plans without 'Chat and Cowork unified', projects created from an existing folder stay on that computer. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Current limitation: projects are only available in Cowork, not in Claude Code; support for Claude Code is planned. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Projects are available on every surface; from a project you can start a chat or a Cowork session, and Claude uses the project's knowledge as context. Projects tied to a local folder support Cowork sessions on desktop only, and Cowork won't change a project's contents, so add anything you want to keep to the project yourself. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15520349-use-claude-cowork-on-web-desktop-and-mobile]

The Cowork docs page describes a different model: projects live on your computer, aren't synced to the cloud or shared with other people. This conflicts with the newer help-center article. [https://claude.com/docs/cowork/guide/projects]
Claude reads individual files up to 50 MB (Cowork projects documentation). [https://claude.com/docs/cowork/guide/projects]

If the message box no longer shows 'Chat' and 'Cowork' options, you have the new Claude experience, and some steps may look different; it is rolling out to Pro, Max and Ultra. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14116274-organize-your-tasks-with-projects-in-claude-cowork]

Global instructions apply to every Cowork session (tone, output format, background on your role); set them at Settings > Cowork > Edit next to Global instructions > Save. In the new experience they are part of 'Instructions for Claude' in Settings > Your Claude. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Folder instructions add project-specific context when you select a local folder on desktop, and Claude can update them itself during a session. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Scheduled tasks are on all paid plans. Type /schedule in any Cowork task or click 'Scheduled' in the left sidebar. 'New task' offers 'Create with Claude' or 'Set up manually'; the manual form asks for a task name, prompt, approval mode, frequency (hourly, daily, weekly, on weekdays, or manually), an optional model and an optional folder. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13854387-schedule-recurring-tasks-in-claude-cowork]

Picking a folder for a scheduled task turns on 'Require this computer', so it runs only while the computer is awake and Claude Desktop is open; otherwise scheduled tasks run remotely, even when the computer is asleep. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13854387-schedule-recurring-tasks-in-claude-cowork]

Safety advice for scheduled tasks: start simple, avoid sensitive data and hard-to-undo actions, review outputs after each run, pause tasks you're not using. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]

Anthropic advises creating a dedicated working folder for Claude instead of granting broad access, and keeping backups of important files. Claude can only read and write files in folders you have connected. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]

Switch to 'Manually approve' when a task touches sensitive files, accounts or sites, uses a new tool, plugin or site, or when mistakes would be hard to undo. You remain responsible for all actions Claude takes on your behalf. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13364135-use-claude-cowork-safely]

Multi-step tasks use more usage than a quick question. Official tips: group related work into one task, start a new conversation for unrelated work, tell Claude when you only need a quick answer, and check Settings > Usage. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork]

Connectors let Claude reach your apps and services and inherit each person's permissions from the connected service. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11176164-use-connectors-to-extend-claude-s-capabilities]
Anthropic open-sourced plugins at the January 2026 launch, including Sales, Finance, Data, Marketing and Productivity. [https://claude.com/resources/articles/cowork-plugins]

Classic chat projects: self-contained workspaces with their own chat histories and knowledge bases, available to all users; Free users can create up to five. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9517075-what-are-projects]

On paid plans, chat project knowledge switches to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) near context limits, expanding capacity by up to 10x. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9517075-what-are-projects]

To create a chat project: go to claude.ai/projects, click '+ New Project', add files with '+' and instructions with 'Set project instructions'. Context is not shared across chats in a project unless added to the project knowledge. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9519177-how-can-i-create-and-manage-projects]

Claude can hallucinate incorrect information; Anthropic says not to rely on it as a single source of truth and to check cited sources for high-stakes work. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8525154-claude-is-providing-incorrect-or-misleading-responses]
